description: NMEA 0183 GGA sentence: a comma-delimited ASCII line starting with $GPGGA or $GNGGA, giving a UTC fix time, latitude/longitude, GPS fix quality, number of satellites, HDOP, and altitude, ending in a *checksum.

NMEA 0183 RMC sentence: a comma-delimited ASCII line starting with $GPRMC or $GNRMC, giving a UTC fix time, status, latitude/longitude, speed over ground in knots, course over ground in degrees, and a ddmmyy date, ending in a *checksum.

Modbus-style marine engine controller telemetry: a JSON object with a timestamp, a device_id, and a registers object mapping small integer register-address strings to raw scaled integer readings such as engine RPM, coolant temperature, fuel level, and engine hours.
